Publication of the chapter **“LIBS Imaging Applications”** in the second edition of *Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy*, edited by Jagdish P. Singh and Surya N. Thakur.

The chapter reviews imaging applications of LIBS across several fields, including biomedical research.
